CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation tied to identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (red) is identified and an origin/organization entry is provided for the same referent/time, separating identification from organization/status.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition linked to content presentation/access.

C.rationale: Coordinates and color attributes are explicitly listed for identified referents.

D.rationale: The report separately lists content (color/coordinates) and an origin/organization metadata for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: Origin/represented_time and candidate/current labels describe how content is organized/presented (current vs candidate/estimated).
